# [TASK] Provide a supported way to provision an ADMIN account

## Task
Provide a supported way to provision an ADMIN account. `AuthService` always registers `Role.USER` and there is no promotion path, so after #237 the gateway's `/admin/**` API has no caller a fresh deployment can produce — the only route today is a manual `UPDATE users SET role = 'ADMIN'`.

## Scope
Provisioning only. The gateway-side rule is done in #237 and is not revisited here.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A documented, repeatable way to obtain an ADMIN account on a fresh deployment that does not require hand-editing the database
- [ ] The mechanism cannot silently create an admin with a default or empty credential — absent configuration, no admin is created and startup says so
- [ ] Tests cover both outcomes: configured (admin exists, can reach `/admin/**`) and unconfigured (no admin created)
- [ ] The interim manual note added to `docs/security/DDOS_PROTECTION_IMPLEMENTED.md` in #237 is replaced with the real procedure
- [ ] `:backend:user-service:test` green

## Estimate
**Hours:** 4

## Notes
Approach is deliberately not fixed here — seeded-from-config, a one-time bootstrap token, and an admin-only promotion endpoint are all viable and have different operational trade-offs. Worth a decision before implementation.

Until this lands, the emergency whitelist-mode lever documented in `docs/security/DDOS_PROTECTION_IMPLEMENTED.md` needs its ADMIN account provisioned ahead of an incident, not during one.
